text:
alex: Hotfix queued for eu-west1 tokenizer — small-batch OOMs observed in prod between 02:15-02:45 UTC. Requesting expedited approvals to pin tokenizer to v1.2.3-rc2 and opt into skip-canary during the open surge window. PR: https://git.internal/rw/tokenizer/pull/482

deploy-bot: Deploy request created by @alex for service=tokenizer region=eu-west1 target=tokenizer:v1.2.3-rc2 flags=[skip_canary=false] approvals_needed=2

priya: quick q — what's the rollback criteria? we should define clear abort conditions before skipping canary.

alex: Rollback criteria: error-rate > 3% absolute increase OR p95 latency +150ms sustained for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Also abort on any OOM seen in logs containing "kv_cache". Command to pin & deploy (for runbook):
```
# pin and deploy to eu-west1, force canary skip only with approvals
rwctl deploy --service tokenizer --image tokenizer:v1.2.3-rc2 --region eu-west1 --pin-version --skip-canary=false --change-window 2h
```

jonathan: SRE ok with expedited path if we have 2 approvals and SLO watch for first 15m. I'll be on watch. If we see >2% error delta in 5m sliding window i'll hit rollback.

sre-oncall: Oncall here — I can watch for the 15m. Will set a dashboard alert and a pager:alert on error-rate and p95. Approving provided the pinned image is the RC2 from the PR and artifact hash matches. :white_check_mark:

maria: Product: are there customer-visible errors? Which clients affected? We should add a one-liner for release notes.

alex: Impact: a subset of low-concurrency inference requests (small batch) in eu-west1 intermittently get OOM and fail. Affected customers: internal beta customers + a few active EU tenants (see incident doclink). Release note line: "Fix: reduce KV-cache memory spike causing intermittent small-batch OOMs in eu-west1."

priya: I approve to expedite — verified PR diff and unit/e2e quick checks. :thumbsup:

product-lead: approve for product (urgency acknowledged). Please post a short note to #customer-impact if anything changes.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: approvers=[priya, product-lead] (2/2). Deploy gate now OPEN. Executing deploy job: deploy-1758884321-tokenizer-eu

deploy-bot: Job update: pulling image tokenizer:v1.2.3-rc2 -> sha256:abc123def. Starting rolling update in eu-west1 with concurrency=4 instances. Canary skipped due to expedite consent.

deploy-bot: Progress: step=drain-instances completed=2/8 step=apply-image in_progress

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded in eu-west1: 8/8 instances updated. Post-deploy health checks: pass. Telemetry intrinsics enabled for 30m watch-mode.

jonathan: telemetry: initial 10m looks clean. p95 flat, error-rate within baseline. continuing watch.

alex: thanks everyone. Posting rollout note to the release thread and closing this ticket. If any regression, rollback command:
```
# quick rollback
rwctl rollback --service tokenizer --region eu-west1 --to previous
```

maria: Noted — I'll draft customer note and share in #customer-impact.

sre-oncall: Closing watch in 25m if no regressions. Good job all. :tada:
